title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security update
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the Linux kernel's net/iucv component affecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 Extended Lifecycle Support. This flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-68140, involves improper handling of a severed iucv_path, which could lead to security issues. Red Hat has issued a security advisory with an important severity rating and released patches to address this vulnerability. Systems must be rebooted after applying the update to ensure the fix takes effect.
